sloka: पपात प्रथमं रामो विद्धो मर्मसु मार्गणैः ।क्रोधादिन्द्रजिता येन पुरा शक्रो विनिर्जितः ।। ६.४५.२२ ।।।।
transliteration: papāta prathamaṁ rāmo viddho marmasu mārgaṇaiḥ ।krodhādindrajitā yena purā śakro vinirjitaḥ ।। 6.45.22 ।।।।

translations.english: Rama fell first pierced by arrows in his vital parts released in anger by Indrajith, by whom Indra was utterly defeated.
